connector.name: Capture Screen MCP
connector.registryDescription: Windows screen capture MCP server with display, region, and active-window capture tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the NuGet package CaptureScreenMcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ochtum account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: CAPTURE_SCREEN_DEFAULT_DISPLAY
env.description: Default display selector when capture_display display argument is omitted.

env.name: CAPTURE_SCREEN_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Default output directory for PNG captures. Default is C:\capture_screen.

env.name: CAPTURE_SCREEN_HIDE_FOREGROUND_WINDOWS_TERMINAL
env.description: Set 0/false/off to disable temporary hiding of overlapping Windows Terminal windows during capture.
